releaseNotes.title: 420 Wallet native release candidate
releaseNotes.summary: Native Android and iOS wallet package with canonical Wallet Core authority, local passkey/session authorization, guarded RPC transport, dApp handoff, push authorization, lifecycle hardening, and release packaging.
releaseNotes.securityNotice: Production Play/TestFlight/App Store readiness remains blocked until npm run device:closeout passes with genuine physical-device evidence.
